accessibility:
- The `label` prop is automatically associated with the inner text input (`htmlFor` plus a generated `id`, or your own `id` if you pass one). While the label is wired it also names the input; without one, the input falls back to `aria-label="Add tag"`, or `labels.input` in your language. Inside a labeled `Field`, that `Field`'s label names the input the same way and replaces the fallback.
- A user-supplied `id` is applied to the inner input (the labellable control), not the wrapper div.
- When `maxTags` is reached the text input turns read-only rather than going away, so keyboard focus stays where it was and the label keeps naming the input. The suggestion list stays closed.
- While the counter shows, it describes the input through `aria-describedby`, so a screen reader hears the count, like "3 / 3" at the limit.
- Tags are keyboard navigable
- Each tag's remove button is named "Remove" and the tag's text, the `field` of an object tag. With `ariaCloseLabel`, every button takes that one name, as for a translation, and is described by its tag's text, so it still says which tag it removes. With a `tagTemplate` it has the one name and no description
- When the last tag's remove button has focus and takes its tag off, as from the keyboard, focus first moves to the remove button before it, or to the input when no tag is left, so it doesn't drop to the page. Any other tag's remove button keeps focus
- With `data`, the input is a `role="combobox"` with `aria-autocomplete="list"` and `aria-haspopup="listbox"`. Its `aria-expanded` is true only while the suggestion list is on screen, and while it is, `aria-controls` points at the list. While no suggestion matches there's no list, so it stays false. Without `data` there's never a list, so the input stays a plain text field
- Focus stays in the input, which points `aria-activedescendant` at the highlighted suggestion as the arrow keys or the mouse move it
- Focus moving from the input to another element closes the suggestion list, as `Tab` to the next field or to a tag's remove button does, so the list doesn't stay open over what has focus. A press on a suggestion keeps focus in the input, so the list stays open for the click, and the list takes no `Tab` stop of its own
- The list is a `role="listbox"` named through `aria-labelledby` by the label that names the input, when that label has an id: the `label` prop's label always has one, and so does a `Field`'s label that the `Field` wires itself. A `Field` label you wire by hand with `labelProps.htmlFor`, which is how the horizontal examples above name the Taginput, needs an `id` in its `labelProps` as well. Otherwise the list falls back to `aria-label="Suggestions"`, or `labels.suggestions` in your language
- The list holds only the suggestions, each a `role="option"` with an id of its own, and the highlighted one has `aria-selected="true"`
- While the input has focus, the box around the tags draws Bulma's focus ring, a border and a shadow in the focus color, or in the `color` you set, inside a `Control` or not
- In forced colors (Windows' contrast themes), which take away the list's shadow and the highlighted suggestion's fill, the open list is drawn with an edge and the highlighted suggestion with an outline in the system's highlight color
- The `message` describes the input through `aria-describedby`, after the counter while it shows, so a screen reader reads both when the input takes focus.
- `aria-invalid` and `aria-errormessage` go on the input, while the other attributes you pass go on the wrapper, so a screen reader hears the input is invalid when it takes focus.
summary: The `Taginput` component provides a tag/chip input field for managing multiple tags.

parts.summary: The `Taginput` component provides a tag/chip input field for managing multiple tags.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label. Automatically associated with the text input via `htmlFor` — uses your `id` when provided, otherwise a generated one. Dropped inside an outer `Field`, whose own label associates instead when that `Field` generates a target id (not `grouped`/`hasAddons`, no explicit `labelProps.htmlFor`) and you set no `id` here; it then replaces the `aria-label="Add tag"` fallback (or `labels.input`) too. With `data`, the label naming the input also names the open suggestion list, through `aria-labelledby`, when it has an id: this label always does, and an outer `Field`'s does unless you wired it by hand without an `id` in its `labelProps`. Otherwise the list is named "Suggestions", or `labels.suggestions`.

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Props for the label element. An explicit `htmlFor` here overrides the automatic association (no id is generated then). With `data`, while the label names the input, the suggestion list's `aria-labelledby` points at it, through an `id` here when you give one and a generated one otherwise.

props.name: id
props.description: Applied to the inner text input (the labellable control), not the wrapper div.

props.name: value
props.description: The current tags (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Default tags (uncontrolled).

props.name: data
props.description: Autocomplete suggestions. With `data` set, even to an empty array, the text input is a `role="combobox"` that controls the suggestion list and points `aria-activedescendant` at the highlighted suggestion. Without it there's no list, so the input stays a plain text field. The list shows the suggestions that contain what's typed, ignoring case, and inside a `LocaleProvider` with a `locale`, ignoring accents too where that language does, so "cafe" finds "Café".

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text when no tags.

props.name: field
props.description: Object property to use as display field.

props.name: allowNew
props.description: Allow creating new tags not in suggestions.

props.name: allowDuplicates
props.description: Allow duplicate tags.

props.name: openOnFocus
props.description: Open autocomplete dropdown on focus.

props.name: removeOnKeys
props.description: Remove tag on backspace. Default: true.

props.name: confirmKeys
props.description: Keys to confirm tag creation. Default: ['Enter', ','].

props.name: closable
props.description: Show close button on tags. Default: true.

props.name: attached
props.description: Attach tags visually.

props.name: maxTags
props.description: Maximum number of tags allowed. At the limit the text input stays but turns read-only, so focus stays put and the label still names it. It takes no more tags and the suggestion list stays closed. Backspace (with `removeOnKeys`) or a tag's remove button makes room again. While the counter shows, it describes the input.

props.name: maxlength
props.description: Maximum length of input.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the input is disabled.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Whether the input is read-only.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Applies rounded corners to the tags.

props.name: ellipsis
props.description: Truncates long tag text with ellipsis.

props.name: hasCounter
props.description: Shows a counter of the number of tags, written the way the `locale` of a `LocaleProvider` around it writes numbers.

props.name: onPasteSeparators
props.description: Characters that split pasted text into tags. Each part goes through the same checks as a typed tag, against the tags before it, the paste's own included, and adding stops at `maxTags`. `onChange` fires once for the whole paste, and `onAdd` once for each tag it adds.

props.name: beforeAdding
props.description: Validation function called before adding a tag.

props.name: createTag
props.description: Custom function for creating tag objects from input.

props.name: keepFirst
props.description: Keeps the first autocomplete suggestion highlighted.

props.name: keepOpen
props.description: Keeps the autocomplete dropdown open after selection.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading spinner in the input. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the spinner stops and stays drawn (with bestax's CSS loaded).

props.name: ariaCloseLabel
props.description: Names each tag's remove button in place of "Remove" and the tag's text, the same name for every button, as for a translation. Each button is then described by its tag's text, so it still says which tag it removes, except with a `tagTemplate`, whose content is left as it renders.

props.name: labels
props.description: The accessible names it gives its parts, in your app's language. A `LocaleProvider` doesn't change them.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon name for the input field.

props.name: iconLibrary
props.description: Icon library to use.

props.name: iconVariant
props.description: Icon style variant (e.g., 'solid', 'outlined').

props.name: iconFeatures
props.description: Additional icon modifiers.

props.name: color
props.description: Input color variant.

props.name: tagColor
props.description: Tag color variant.

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. When set, one hidden input per tag is rendered.

props.name: form
props.description: Optional id of the form the hidden inputs belong to.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback when tags change.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Callback when tag is added.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Callback when tag is removed. When it's the last tag and its remove button had focus, focus has already moved to the remove button before it, or to the input, as it fires.

props.name: onTyping
props.description: Callback when typing in input.

props.name: tagTemplate
props.description: Custom render for tags.

props.name: labelSize
props.description: Size for the label (used in horizontal layouts).

props.name: horizontal
props.description: Horizontal field layout.

props.name: message
props.description: Help or validation text under the widget. It describes the control its label names through `aria-describedby`, so a screen reader reads it there.

props.name: messageColor
props.description: Bulma color for the message.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Field wrapper.

extraProps.name: ref
extraProps.description: Ref forwarded to the input element.
